resource: HyPrColoc R package (Foley et al. 2021 Nat Commun; jrs95/hyprcoloc)
install: R CMD INSTALL --no-build-vignettes into conda env /opt/homebrew/Caskroom/miniforge/base/envs/hi-sprint4 (R 4.4.3)
local_patch: pipelines/sprint5a/hyprcoloc_eigen_cast.patch — src/align1.cpp, align2.cpp, align12.cpp, regional2.cpp: RHO(i,j) indices wrapped in (int) casts. RcppEigen 0.3.4.0.2 (Eigen 3.4) resolves RHO(double,double) to an IndexedView and fails to compile; the cast restores scalar element access. No numerical logic changed. The package example (test.betas/test.ses) ran and returned 3 clusters as documented.
dependencies_added_to_env: conda-forge: r-rmpfr 1.1.1, r-iterpc 0.4.2, r-pheatmap 1.0.13, r-rcppeigen 0.3.4.0.2, r-knitr, r-rmarkdown, r-rcolorbrewer. NOTE: an unpinned first mamba install upgraded r-base to 4.5.3; it was immediately reverted to r-base 4.4.3 with coloc 5.2.3 and susieR 0.14.2 pinned (verified by packageVersion).
